title.about: A navigation or dialog title. Recorded from "Forget the calibration?", since reworded; the budget stands.

label.about: A field, stat, phase or menu label: one line, a few words. Recorded from "Or measure the egg — fill in any one".

segment.about: One option of a segmented control, two or three sharing a phone's width. Recorded from "Set right through", since retired; the budget stands.

tick.about: A doneness word under the slider, five sharing a phone's width. Recorded from "Runny", "Jammy" and "Fudgy".

button.about: A button. Recorded from "They're in the ice bath".

headline.about: The big readout, in place of the clock, on one line. Recorded from "Last Wednesday".

body.about: A sentence or a few, wrapping freely. Recorded from the sous-vide warning (251); raised in F3, when both of its temperatures gained a unit and °F runs a digit longer.

more.about: A paragraph opened in place by an (i) beside a control (UI.md section 4): the intuition behind a short label. Set in the redesign from the longest English, the cooling choice's (461), with a fifth to spare for languages that run longer; on a 390 px phone that is about twelve lines.

help.about: A paragraph or a source on the Help page, which the cook opens on purpose to read. Set in the redesign from the longest English paragraph (391) with room to spare; a paragraph that outgrows it should become two.

clause.about: A clause of the web setup sentence ("into cold water, brought to the boil and left to stand"): a tappable part of a sentence that wraps, not a fragment spliced into a one-line summary. Recorded 27 September from the longest, 54.

fragment.about: A piece inserted into another message: a texture, a duration, a weekday, a method. Recorded from "yolk soft, barely thickened".

a11y.about: Read by a screen reader, never drawn. Recorded from the sous-vide announcement (88); raised in F3, when its subline's bath temperature gained a unit and a parenthesis: "… 22 h 43 min in the bath (136 °F), to eat now".

notification.title.about: The alarm's title on the Lock Screen. Recorded from "Eggs out — now".

notification.body.about: The alarm's body. Recorded from "Straight into the cooling, or the yolk keeps cooking." (53); raised in F6 to hold the 1750 body the owner approved on 26 September, "Commit them at once to the cold; for heat, though withdrawn from the fire, is not yet withdrawn from the egg." (109), which a Lock Screen notification shows in about three lines of its four. Not yet seen on a device.

lockscreen.about: The Live Activity's line on the Lock Screen, beside the countdown. Recorded from "68 g · jammy · peak yolk 65°C" (29); raised in F3 for the unit, from "2.4 oz · jammy · peak yolk 149 °F". It may wrap to a second line.

island.expanded.about: The expanded Dynamic Island, and the Lock Screen's stage and note. Recorded from "into the cooling, or the yolk keeps going".

island.compact.about: The compact Dynamic Island, in place of the countdown. Recorded from "NOW" and "Eat".
